summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of €750 million 6.061% senior unsecured notes due 2035, fixed-rate until 2034 then floating rate based on SONIA plus 1.440%. The notes are issued under a base indenture and forty-first supplemental indenture, with an issue date of September 11, 2026, and maturity September 11, 2035. Redemption features include make-whole and par redemption options, plus loss-absorption and tax-event provisions. Noteholders consent to UK bail-in powers. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation.
